Topic Change · 英语变化动词精讲

Let's Learn English! Topic Change! — Learn English with Bob the Canadian

来源：Bob the Canadian（英语教师 Bob） · 音频时长约 24分16秒 · 学习模块锚点导航 · 默认白天模式可切暗黑

听力理解

完整转录 · 带时间戳

[00:00]Well, hello and welcome to this English lesson about change. Change is all around us. People change, trees change, even something like your house will change over time.

[00:17]So we are surrounded by things that change and we ourselves also change over time. So I thought I would do an English lesson about the verbs we use to talk about change.

[00:35]In this lesson, I'll look at a number of different verbs. I think about 25 verbs and I will give you a nice picture, an example sentence, and a definition, of course, of what it means.

[00:49]To change. So this is the general verb meaning to become different or to make something different. So something can change over time, but you can also change something by what you do.

[01:01]So here we have the classic example. The leaves on the trees will change throughout the season. In my part of the world, we have four distinct seasons and the trees will change.

[01:26]To change into — to become different from what it was before. To me, this is the classic example. The caterpillar will change into a butterfly.

[01:45]Sometimes we just say change to, but it sounds better to me if we use into. The caterpillar will change into a butterfly and this does happen quite regularly on our farm.

[02:03]To turn into — to change and become something different. So the rain will turn into snow later today. Sometimes they're interchangeable: the rain will turn into snow, turn to snow, change to snow or change into snow.

[02:34]To become — to begin to be something different over time. As a child gets older, they become more mature. He went back to school to become a doctor.

[03:05]To transform — to change something greatly in appearance, form or character. So they transform the old barn into a beautiful banquet hall. The barn has been transformed.

[03:38]To adapt — to change your behavior or methods to fit a new situation. It will take me a few weeks to adapt to my new workload. I was used to being more relaxed every day.

[04:09]I need to change my behavior and methods to fit the new situation of being at work. So to adapt, to change your behavior methods to fit a new situation.

[04:24]To adjust — to make a small change so that something works or feels better. I had to adjust my new chair several times until I got it just right. Just right meaning perfect.

[04:51]To modify — to make small changes to something, to improve it or make it more suitable. This person decided to modify his bike so his kid could ride with him.

[05:25]To alter — to change something so that it is slightly different. The tailor took his measurements so he could alter his pants. I don't get my clothes altered, or we also say tailored.

[05:55]To revise — to change something you have written or planned in order to improve it. I tend to revise my lesson plans a lot during the first few days of school.

[06:22]To edit — to make changes to writing, photos, audio or video, to improve the finished product. I have to edit my videos before uploading them or else they would be quite boring.

[06:58]To upgrade — to replace or improve something with a newer or better version. I upgraded my computer with faster memory, or you can also say RAM.

[07:33]To replace — to remove one thing and put another thing in its place. I replaced the car battery with a new one. Last time this happened, it happened to my sister.

[08:07]To switch — to stop using or doing one thing and start using or doing another. I decided to switch from drinking coffee to drinking tea.

[08:38]To swap — I like this one. It's fun to say. To exchange one thing for another. I like apples better than oranges, so my colleague and I swapped.

[09:05]We have to swap our regular tires for snow tires later this year. The mechanic or my son will take the old summer tires off and put the winter tires on. So we'll swap tires.

[09:27]To convert — to change something into a different form or make it suitable for a different use. They converted the garage into a bedroom. How is this different to transform? It's not.

[09:56]To deteriorate — to gradually become worse in condition or quality. A wooden fence will deteriorate over time. It will eventually start to rot, it will start to fall apart.

[10:31]To ripen — to become ripe and ready to eat. When you pick a green tomato, eventually it will ripen and turn red. The tomatoes will ripen over time.

[11:04]To develop — to gradually grow or change. In order to develop stronger muscles, you must increase the amount you lift. You want your muscles to continue to develop.

[11:43]To worsen — to become worse than before. The weather will worsen throughout the day. Maybe in the morning it's sunny, but the weather forecast says the weather will worsen throughout the day.

[12:18]To fade — to gradually lose color, brightness or strength. The curtains will fade after years in the sun. Sound can also fade — you can fade the music down.

[12:52]To shrink — to become smaller in size. A cotton shirt will shrink the first time you wash it and put it in the dryer. Past tense: shrunk. Pre-shrunk means they already tried to make it shrink a little bit.

[13:24]To reverse — to change something to the opposite direction, order or decision. The store reversed its decision to close and decided to stay open. The government often reverses their decisions.

[13:55]To increase — to become greater in amount, number, size or level. The price of gas will increase this week. The price of gas will go up this week. Go up is an equivalent.

[14:17]To decrease — to become smaller or less in amount, number, size or level. I don't think the price of gas is going to decrease anytime soon. The common way to say this is: it's going to come down.

[14:43]To age — to become older or change as time passes. The wood will begin to age over time. We also have a verb to weather: the wood will weather over time as it's exposed to the sun and rain and snow.

地道句式

核心表达 · 举一反三 · 2-3个例句

句式 1Change is all around us.
变化无处不在。
举一反三：all around us = 在我们周围到处（状语短语）；同义替换：everywhere around us / all about us；场景迁移：Good ideas are all around us.（好点子无处不在。）
Music is all around us in this city.
这座城市里音乐无处不在。
Opportunities are all around you — just look.
机会就在你身边——只要去看。
The forest is all around our house.
森林环绕着我们的房子。
句式 2We are surrounded by things that change.
我们被不断变化的事物包围着。
举一反三：be surrounded by = 被……包围（被动语态）；things that change = 定语从句修饰 things；同义替换：We live among things that change.
The house is surrounded by tall trees.
房子被大树环绕。
She was surrounded by her friends.
她被朋友们围着。
We are surrounded by technology every day.
我们每天都被科技包围。
句式 3To change — to become different or to make something different.
change：变成不同，或使某物不同（既可是不及物，也可是及物）。
举一反三：change 双用法：sth changes（自动变化）/ change sth（人为改变）；同义替换：become different / alter / make different
The weather changes quickly in fall.
秋天天气变得很快。
We need to change our plan.
我们需要改变计划。
Her attitude has changed a lot.
她的态度变了很多。
句式 4The caterpillar will change into a butterfly.
毛毛虫会变成蝴蝶。
举一反三：change into = 变成（强调形态完全转变）；同义替换：turn into / transform into / become；场景迁移：The frog will change into a prince in the story.
The tadpole changes into a frog.
蝌蚪会变成青蛙。
Ice changes into water when it melts.
冰融化时变成水。
The ugly duckling changed into a swan.
丑小鸭变成了天鹅。
句式 5The rain will turn into snow later today.
今天晚些时候雨会变成雪。
举一反三：turn into = 变成（口语常用，与 change into 可互换）；later today = 今天稍晚；同义替换：The rain will change to snow later today.
The movie turned into a huge success.
这部电影大获成功。
His joke turned into a real argument.
他的玩笑演变成了一场争吵。
Water turns into ice below zero degrees.
水在零度以下变成冰。
句式 6As a child gets older, they become more mature.
随着孩子长大，他们会变得更成熟。
举一反三：as = 随着（时间状语从句）；become + 形容词 = 变得……（系动词）；同义替换：as time goes by, they grow more mature
As you practice more, you become better.
练得越多，变得越好。
He became more confident after the speech.
演讲后他变得更自信了。
As the day went on, it became hotter.
随着白天的推移，天气变得更热。
句式 7They transform the old barn into a beautiful banquet hall.
他们把旧谷仓改造成了一座漂亮的宴会厅。
举一反三：transform A into B = 把A改造成B（大幅改变外观/用途）；同义替换：convert A into B / turn A into B；场景迁移：They transformed the basement into a home theater.
The team transformed the empty lot into a park.
团队把空地改造成了公园。
She transformed her hobby into a business.
她把爱好变成了事业。
Technology has transformed the way we live.
科技改变了我们的生活方式。
句式 8It will take me a few weeks to adapt to my new workload.
我需要几周时间来适应新的工作量。
举一反三：it takes sb + 时间 + to do = 做某事需要某人多久；adapt to = 适应（to 是介词）；同义替换：get used to / adjust to
It took me a month to adapt to the new city.
我花了一个月适应新城市。
She adapted to the cold weather quickly.
她很快适应了寒冷天气。
It will take you some time to adapt to online classes.
适应网课需要一些时间。
句式 9I was used to being more relaxed every day.
我以前习惯每天更放松的状态。
举一反三：be used to doing = 习惯于做某事（to 是介词，后接动名词）；区别于 used to do = 过去常常；同义替换：be accustomed to doing
I'm used to getting up early now.
我现在习惯早起了。
She is used to working under pressure.
她习惯在压力下工作。
He is not used to eating spicy food.
他不习惯吃辣。
句式 10I had to adjust my new chair several times until I got it just right.
我不得不反复调整新椅子，直到调到刚刚好。
举一反三：had to do = 不得不做（过去）；until = 直到（时间状语从句）；just right = 刚刚好、完美（口语）
I adjusted the volume until it was just right.
我调音量直到刚刚好。
You may need to adjust your schedule.
你可能需要调整日程。
The soup needs more salt to taste just right.
汤需要再加点盐才够味。
句式 11He decided to modify his bike so his kid could ride with him.
他决定改装自行车，好让他的孩子能一起骑。
举一反三：decide to do = 决定做；so + 从句 = 以便、所以（目的/结果）；同义替换：so that his kid could ride with him
We modified the plan so everyone could join.
我们修改了计划，让每个人都能参加。
She modified the recipe to make it healthier.
她改良了食谱让它更健康。
He modified his car for better performance.
他改装汽车以获得更好的性能。
句式 12The tailor took his measurements so he could alter his pants.
裁缝量了他的尺寸，好改他的裤子。
举一反三：take one's measurements = 量尺寸；so he could... = 以便他能够……（目的从句）；同义替换：take measurements of sb / measure sb
The tailor took my measurements for the suit.
裁缝为我的西装量了尺寸。
I need to alter these jeans — they're too long.
我得改一下这条牛仔裤，太长了。
She altered the dress to fit perfectly.
她改了裙子让它完美合身。
句式 13I tend to revise my lesson plans a lot during the first few days of school.
开学头几天我往往会大量修改教案。
举一反三：tend to do = 倾向于、往往会做；during + 时间段 = 在……期间；同义替换：I usually revise / I often revise
He tends to arrive early for meetings.
他开会往往到得很早。
People tend to forget what they don't use.
人们往往会忘记不用的东西。
She tends to revise her essays several times.
她往往会修改好几遍文章。
句式 14I have to edit my videos before uploading them, or else they would be quite boring.
我必须在发布视频前剪辑，否则视频会很无聊。
举一反三：have to do = 必须做（客观需要）；before + doing = 在……之前；or else = 否则（口语警告/后果）
Hurry up, or else we'll be late.
快点，否则我们要迟到了。
You should back up your files, or else you might lose them.
你应该备份文件，否则可能会丢失。
She edits her photos before posting them.
她发照片前会先修图。
句式 15I upgraded my computer with faster memory.
我用更快的运行内存升级了电脑。
举一反三：upgrade sth with sth = 用……升级某物；faster memory = 更快的内存（RAM）；同义替换：upgrade to a newer version
I upgraded my phone to the latest model.
我把手机升级到了最新款。
The airline upgraded us to first class.
航空公司把我们升到了头等舱。
She upgraded her skills with an online course.
她通过在线课程升级了技能。
句式 16I replaced the car battery with a new one.
我换了一个新汽车电瓶。
举一反三：replace A with B = 用B替换A；同义替换：swap A for B / substitute B for A；场景迁移：They replaced the old windows with double-glazed ones.
She replaced her old laptop with a new one.
她用新笔记本换掉了旧的。
We replaced the carpet with wooden floors.
我们把地毯换成了木地板。
They replaced the broken part with a spare.
他们用备件替换了坏掉的部件。
句式 17I decided to switch from drinking coffee to drinking tea.
我决定从喝咖啡改为喝茶。
举一反三：switch from A to B = 从A切换到B（改变习惯/选择）；decide to do = 决定做；同义替换：change from...to... / move from...to...
He switched from smoking to vaping.
他从抽烟改成了抽电子烟。
She switched from English to French classes.
她把英语课换成了法语课。
I switched from paper books to e-books.
我从纸质书改用了电子书。
句式 18I like apples better than oranges, so my colleague and I swapped.
比起橙子我更喜欢苹果，所以同事和我交换了（食物）。
举一反三：like A better than B = 比起B更喜欢A；so = 所以（因果）；swap（v.）交换 = trade / exchange
I like tea better than coffee.
比起咖啡我更喜欢茶。
We swapped seats so I could see the screen.
我们换了座位好让我看到屏幕。
Let's swap numbers so we can keep in touch.
我们交换号码保持联系吧。
句式 19We have to swap our regular tires for snow tires later this year.
今年晚些时候我们得把普通轮胎换成雪地胎。
举一反三：swap A for B = 用A换B（互易）；regular tires / snow tires = 普通胎/雪地胎；场景迁移：Can I swap this shirt for a larger size?
I swapped my sandwich for her salad.
我用三明治换了她的沙拉。
He swapped his old phone for a newer one.
他用旧手机换了个新的。
We swapped our tickets for better seats.
我们把票换成了更好的座位。
句式 20They converted the garage into a bedroom.
他们把车库改造成了卧室。
举一反三：convert A into B = 把A改造成B（改变用途）；与 transform 的区别：convert 侧重「用途转换」；同义替换：turn the garage into a bedroom
They converted the attic into a study.
他们把阁楼改成了书房。
The factory was converted into a museum.
工厂被改造成了博物馆。
We converted the spare room into a gym.
我们把空房间改成了健身房。
句式 21A wooden fence will deteriorate over time.
木栅栏会随时间推移而老化。
举一反三：deteriorate = 恶化、老化（gradually become worse）；over time = 随着时间推移；同义替换：decay / rot / get worse over time
Old buildings deteriorate without maintenance.
老建筑不维护会逐渐破败。
His health deteriorated after the accident.
事故后他的健康状况恶化了。
The relationship deteriorated over the years.
这段关系逐年恶化。
句式 22The tomatoes will ripen over time.
西红柿会随时间逐渐成熟。
举一反三：ripen = 成熟（不及物动词）；ripe（形容词）= 成熟的，ripened（过去式）；同义替换：become ripe / mature
The bananas will ripen in a few days.
香蕉几天后就会熟。
The fruit ripens quickly in the sun.
水果在阳光下熟得快。
Wait for the avocados to ripen before eating.
等牛油果熟了再吃。
句式 23In order to develop stronger muscles, you must increase the amount you lift.
为了练出更强壮的肌肉，你必须增加举重的重量。
举一反三：in order to do = 为了（目的状语）；increase the amount = 增加数量；同义替换：so as to / to + 动词原形（表目的）
In order to pass the exam, you must study hard.
为了通过考试，你必须努力学习。
He increased the amount of water he drinks daily.
他增加了每天的饮水量。
She works out daily in order to stay fit.
她为了保持健康每天锻炼。
句式 24The weather will worsen throughout the day.
天气全天会逐渐变坏。
举一反三：worsen = 恶化（= become worse）；throughout the day = 一整天（从头到尾）；同义替换：get worse as the day goes by
The traffic will worsen during rush hour.
高峰时段交通会恶化。
His condition worsened overnight.
他的病情一夜之间恶化了。
The storm worsened as it approached the coast.
暴风雨接近海岸时变得更猛烈。
句式 25The curtains will fade after years in the sun.
窗帘在阳光下晒几年就会褪色。
举一反三：fade = 褪色、变淡（颜色/亮度/力量渐失）；after years in the sun = 在阳光下多年后；同义替换：lose color / become dull
The photo has faded with age.
照片随时间褪色了。
Her memory of the event slowly faded.
她对那件事的记忆慢慢淡去。
The music faded out at the end of the song.
歌曲结尾音乐渐弱。
句式 26A cotton shirt will shrink the first time you wash it and put it in the dryer.
棉衬衫第一次洗后放进烘干机就会缩水。
举一反三：shrink = 缩水（shrank/shrunk）；the first time + 从句 = 第一次……时；同义替换：get smaller / become smaller in size
My jeans shrank in the wash.
我的牛仔裤洗后缩水了。
The sweater shrank two sizes.
毛衣缩了两个码。
Don't put wool in the dryer or it will shrink.
别把羊毛放进烘干机，会缩水。
句式 27The store reversed its decision to close and decided to stay open.
商店撤销了关门的决定，决定继续营业。
举一反三：reverse one's decision = 撤销决定、翻盘；decide to do = 决定做；同义替换：change one's mind / cancel the decision
The company reversed its decision to raise prices.
公司撤销了涨价的决定。
He reversed the car into the parking spot.
他把车倒进停车位。
The judge reversed the earlier ruling.
法官推翻了早先的裁决。
句式 28The price of gas will increase this week.
汽油价格本周会上涨。
举一反三：increase = 增加、上涨（动词/名词同形）；同义替换：go up / rise / climb；场景迁移：The price of gas will go up this week.（口语更常用）
Sales increased by 20% last month.
上个月销售额增长了20%。
Temperatures will increase over the weekend.
周末气温会升高。
There was an increase in online orders.
网上订单增加了。
句式 29I don't think the price of gas is going to decrease anytime soon.
我认为汽油价格短期内不会下跌。
举一反三：don't think + 从句 = 我不认为……（否定前移）；be going to = 将要（预测）；anytime soon = 短期内、近期（常用于否定）
I don't think it will rain tomorrow.
我觉得明天不会下雨。
Prices won't decrease anytime soon.
价格短期内不会降。
She doesn't think he will come to the party.
她觉得他不会来聚会。
句式 30The wood will begin to age over time.
木材会随时间开始老化。
举一反三：begin to do = 开始做；age（动词）= 老化、变老（名词转动词）；同义替换：weather / mature over time
The building has aged beautifully.
这栋建筑优雅地老去了。
She has aged a lot since I last saw her.
自上次见面后她老了许多。
Wine ages in wooden barrels.
葡萄酒在木桶中陈酿。
句式 31They've stood the test of time.
它们经受住了时间的考验。
举一反三：stand the test of time = 经得起时间考验（习语）；stand = 承受、经受；同义替换：withstand the test of time / last well
Good music stands the test of time.
好音乐经得起时间考验。
Their friendship has stood the test of time.
他们的友谊经受了时间的考验。
This design will stand the test of time.
这个设计经得起时间考验。
句式 32I'm going to have another sip of water here, just so that I can keep talking for an hour.
我要在这里再喝一口水，好让自己能继续说一个小时。
举一反三：a sip of = 一小口（量词）；just so that = 正是为了（目的从句强调）；keep doing = 持续做
He took a sip of coffee before answering.
他先抿了一口咖啡才回答。
I saved some cake so that you could try it.
我留了些蛋糕好让你尝尝。
Keep practicing so that you improve quickly.
坚持练习才能进步得快。
句式 33This might not happen in your part of the world.
在你们那边（的世界）可能不会发生这种事。
举一反三：might not = 可能不（推测否定）；your part of the world = 你们所在的地区（委婉说法）；同义替换：where you live / your area
It might not happen again for years.
这种事可能多年不会再发生。
People in my part of the world love maple syrup.
我们那边的人喜欢枫糖浆。
The weather might not be so cold in your part of the world.
你们那边天气可能没那么冷。
句式 34It hasn't quite started happening yet.
（这件事）还没有真正开始发生。
举一反三：hasn't quite...yet = 还没有完全……（现在完成时+yet）；quite = 完全（程度强调）；同义替换：It hasn't really begun yet.
I haven't quite finished my homework yet.
我还没完全写完作业。
It hasn't quite started raining yet.
雨还没有真正下起来。
She hasn't quite decided yet.
她还没有完全决定。

缩读 / 连读发音

语音现象拆解 · 听原声对比

语音点 1will 的弱读：will change / wəl tʃeɪndʒ/
will 在口语中常弱读为 /wəl/，几乎听不见完整的 /wɪl/。
助动词 will 在句中不重读时弱化为 /wəl/（甚至 /əl/）。Bob 说 the leaves will change 时，will 非常轻，紧贴在 change 前。初学者常误以为没有 will，导致漏掉「将来时」信息。

这需要我……（will 缩成 /əl/）
语音点 2change into 的连读：/tʃeɪndʒɪntə/
change 末尾的 /dʒ/ 与 into 的 /ɪ/ 直接连读，听成一个词。
辅音 + 元音连读：change into → /tʃeɪndʒ ɪntə/，into 的 i 与 change 的尾音拼合，听起来像 change-into 一个整体。into 弱读时也可接近 /ɪntə/。

语音点 3later today 的弹舌音 /t/：/ˈleɪt̬ər/
美音中 t 在两个元音之间变成弹舌音（flap t），later 听起来像 /leɪdər/。
later 的 t 处于两个元音之间（a—e），美音发成弹舌音 /t̬/（接近 d）。这是美音与英音最明显的区别之一。Bob 是加拿大人，同样使用美式发音习惯。

语法要点

深入语法分析 · 结构拆解 · 易错点

语法 1及物 vs 不及物：change 的两种用法
The leaves will change（不及物，自动变化）；You can also change something by what you do（及物，人为改变）。
这是英语「变化类动词」的核心区别：不及物用法（S+V）表示「主语自身发生变化」，及物用法（S+V+O）表示「主语使宾语发生变化」。对比：The door opened（门自己开了，不及物）vs I opened the door（我开门，及物）。change 两用；turn/ripen/fade/shrink 通常不及物；modify/alter/edit/replace/upgrade 通常及物；transform/convert 及物 + into 短语。

同一声源片段已在上方模块嵌入，请向上滚动播放（）

The weather changed suddenly.（不及物）
天气突然变了。
We changed the plan.（及物）
我们改了计划。
The caterpillar changes into a butterfly.（不及物+介词短语）
毛毛虫变成蝴蝶。
语法 2turn into / change into / become 的替换关系
Sometimes they're interchangeable：The rain will turn into snow = change into snow = turn to snow = change to snow。
become、turn into、change into、transform into、convert into 都可表「变成」，但细微差别：become 侧重「结果状态」（成为），多接名词/形容词；turn into 侧重「自然或戏剧性的转变」，口语高频；transform/convert 强调「人为的大幅改造」。Bob 明确说它们是可互换的，但学习者掌握各自侧重能更精准表达。

同一声源片段已在上方模块嵌入，请向上滚动播放（）

The milk turned sour overnight.（become 接形容词）
牛奶一夜之间变酸了。
She turned into a confident speaker.（turn into）
她变成了自信的演讲者。
The old factory was converted into a museum.（convert 被动）
旧工厂被改造成了博物馆。
语法 3become + 形容词/名词：系动词用法
As a child gets older, they become more mature. He went back to school to become a doctor.
become 是系动词（linking verb），后接形容词表语（more mature）或名词表语（a doctor）。系动词后永远用形容词而非副词。与 be 不同，become 强调「逐渐变成」的过程。get/grow 也可作类似系动词：get older = grow older = become older。

那部电影后她出名了。

他成了职业选手。
It gets dark early in winter.（get 系动词）
冬天天黑得早。
语法 4adapt to：介词 to 而非不定式 to
It will take me a few weeks to adapt to my new workload.
adapt/adjust 后接 to + 名词/动名词，这里的 to 是介词，不是不定式标志。因此后面接动词时必须用 -ing：adapt to working（不是 adapt to work）。同类搭配：be/get used to doing、look forward to doing、be accustomed to doing。学习者最常见的错误是 to 后面误加动词原形。

语法 5be used to doing vs used to do：两个易混结构
I was used to being more relaxed every day（过去习惯于）；对比 used to live（过去常常）。
① be/get used to + doing = 习惯于做某事（to 是介词）；② used to + do = 过去常常做（现在不做了，to 是不定式标志）。发音均为 /juːstə/，只能靠后接形式区分。时态变化：be used to 可随 be 变换时态（was/will be used to）。

You'll soon get used to the new schedule.（get used to）
你很快会适应新作息。
语法 6have sth done：使役被动结构
I don't get my clothes altered. The tailor took his measurements so he could alter his pants.
have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词 = 使某事被做（主语不亲自做，而是让别人做）。get my clothes altered = 让别人改我的衣服。此结构还可表「遭遇」：have my car stolen（车被偷了）。get 比 have 更口语化。

她把照片打印了。
He got his bike repaired at the shop.

语法 7I tend to do：一般现在时表习惯倾向
I tend to revise my lesson plans a lot during the first few days of school.
tend to do = 往往会、倾向于做某事，用一般现在时表示「常态倾向」，常与频率副词（a lot, often, usually）搭配。注意 it takes...结构：It takes sb + time + to do，主语是 it，真正的主语是后面的不定式。

语法 8if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will：将来条件句
If you build a wooden fence, it will deteriorate over time.（Bob 未明说但例句结构隐含：A wooden fence will deteriorate over time if...）
将来条件句规则：if/when/once/as soon as 引导的时间/条件从句中，用一般现在时代替将来时，主句用 will。错误示例 ✗ If it will rain；正确 ✓ If it rains, we will stay home。这是中国学习者高频错误点。

语法 9the first time + 从句：时间状语从句的时态
A cotton shirt will shrink the first time you wash it and put it in the dryer.
the first time（以及 every time, the next time, the moment）可直接作连词引导时间状语从句，从句用一般现在时表将来，主句用 will。此句中有两个并列动词 wash 和 put，共享主语 you，结构紧凑。

语法 10reverse + 宾语：及物动词的「撤销决定」用法
The store reversed its decision to close and decided to stay open.
reverse 是及物动词，直接接宾语：reverse a decision/ruling/trend。句中 reverse its decision to close（不定式 to close 作 decision 的后置定语）+ decided to stay open（decide to do 结构）形成「撤销 A，决定 B」的对比。反义方向词还有 reverse the order（颠倒顺序）、reverse a car（倒车）。

The mayor reversed his earlier decision.
市长撤销了早先的决定。
She reversed the order of the list.
她把列表顺序颠倒了。
The new evidence reversed the verdict.
新证据推翻了判决。
语法 11I don't think + 从句：否定前移
I don't think the price of gas is going to decrease anytime soon.
表达「我认为……不会」时，英语习惯把否定放在主句（don't think），从句用肯定形式。对比中文「我不认为会跌」→ 英文 I don't think it will drop（√）而非 I think it won't drop（△ 虽语法可但不自然）。主句动词 think/believe/expect 均适用。

I don't think he will come.
我觉得他不会来。
She doesn't believe the story is true.
她认为这个故事不真实。
We don't expect prices to rise soon.
我们认为价格短期内不会上涨。
语法 12名词转动词：age / weather / mature
The wood will begin to age over time. The wood will weather over time. 名词可直接当动词用。
英语中大量名词可「零派生」为动词：age（年龄→老化）、weather（天气→风化）、mature（成熟→使成熟）、ripen（ripe→成熟）。这是英语的灵活之处，也是高级表达的来源：She mothers her students（像妈妈一样照顾）、The book hit shelves（上架）。

文化背景

Bob the Canadian 是加拿大安大略省的一位英语教师和农场主，与妻子 Jen 共同经营 YouTube 英语教学频道，以「教室+农场」双场景教学闻名。他的课程风格亲切、语速适中，非常适合作英语听力入门材料。
本课主题 Topic Change（话题/事物变化）恰好呼应加拿大的四季分明：春季融雪、夏季葱郁、秋季枫叶变色、冬季大雪。Bob 说 in my part of the world, we have four distinct seasons——这是他反复强调的加拿大地理特色。
「We have to swap our regular tires for snow tires later this year」是加拿大冬季生活的真实写照：法律规定冬季必须使用雪地胎，每年秋季家家户户都要去 Canadian Tire（加拿大知名零售连锁店）换胎。换胎是加拿大人的年度仪式。
英文中表示「变化」的动词极多，Bob 一堂课就讲了约 25 个（change, turn into, become, transform, adapt, adjust, modify, alter, revise, edit, upgrade, replace, switch, swap, convert, deteriorate, ripen, develop, worsen, fade, shrink, reverse, increase, decrease, age, weather, mature）。学会区分「自动变化（不及物）」与「人为改变（及物）」是掌握这类动词的关键。
枫叶（maple leaf）是加拿大的国家象征，秋季枫叶由绿变红正是本课 change into / turn into 的天然例证。Bob 在农场拍摄时经常以枫树、谷仓、雪地作为教学背景，本课提到的 transform the old barn into a banquet hall 也是北美乡村常见的改造活动。
